summary: Learn AI for procurement with practical sourcing, supplier, and risk workflows. Build scorecards, dashboards, and reports. Enquire today.
lede: Procurement AI training helps procurement professionals apply AI to spend analysis, sourcing decisions, and supplier oversight. Through practical exercises, they structure spend data, design AI-supported RFx evaluations with weighted scoring, and identify supplier risk indicators and exception trends. They also practice turning supplier performance measures into scorecards and dashboard reports, with attention to data quality, confidentiality, and procurement controls.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for procurement professionals who need to use AI in daily sourcing and supplier decisions, not just discuss it conceptually.
audience: Contract Managers using AI to review clauses
prerequisites: Intermediate familiarity with procurement, sourcing, or supplier management is expected. You should have working knowledge of category management, RFx processes, supplier evaluation, and basic spreadsheet analysis. No coding is required, but you should be comfortable interpreting procurement data, working with supplier records, and reviewing AI-generated outputs for accuracy and policy alignment. Access to procurement spend data or a sample supplier list will be helpful for the exercises, though training datasets and lab templates can be provided.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
